enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up with hot water
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse. Wash hair with shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and tea) using the toaster, kettle and refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Open toaster. Insert bread. Press lever. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Take out mug. Take out tea bag. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Remove toast. Place on plate. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir. Remove tea bag. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Stand up. Wash plate and mug.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing study materials and getting ready for campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open backpack. Place laptop in backpack. Place notebooks. Place pens. Place charger. Zip backpack. Put on jacket. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Check time. Pick up backpack. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to Monash Clayton campus for study
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Look at phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk to train station. Enter station. Tap card. Walk to platform. Wait for train. Board train. Sit down. Ride train. Alight train. Walk to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Education lectures and seminars on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Find seat. Sit down. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Open notebook. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Raise hand. Ask question. Lower hand. Continue writing. Look at slides. Turn page. Write more notes. Check time. Pack up. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch and doing required reading on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Buy food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Open book. Read. Turn page. Take notes. Close book. Stand up. Clear tray. Walk to library. Find seat. Sit down. Open book. Read. Turn page.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending tutorials and group work, and researching in the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to tutorial room. Sit down. Participate in discussion. Raise hand. Speak. Listen to group members. Write notes. Work on group task. Present findings. Walk to library. Find book. Sit at table. Read book. Take notes. Use computer. Type notes. Print article. Walk out of library.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk to train station. Enter station. Tap card. Walk to platform. Wait for train. Board train. Sit down. Ride train. Alight train. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker and rice cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Turn on rice cooker. Add rice. Add water. Close lid. Press cook button. Wait. Stir food. Turn off induction cooker. Scoop rice into bowl. Scoop vegetables into bowl. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work uniform and checking shift notes on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out uniform. Take off clothes. Put on uniform. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open shift notes app. Read notes. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the part-time hospitality venue
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk to venue.

enriched_activities.activity: Working part-time hospitality shift serving customers and tidying the service area
enriched_activities.desc: Enter venue. Clock in. Put on apron. Greet customers. Say 'Hello, how can I help you?' Take orders. Write down orders. Enter orders into system. Serve food. Clear tables. Wipe tables. Carry dishes to kitchen. Wash dishes. Restock cutlery. Wipe counter. Say 'Thank you, goodbye.' Clock out. Take off apron. Walk out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding, charging phone, setting alarm and going to bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Take off uniform. Put on pajamas. Pick up phone. Plug charger into phone. Plug charger into wall. Place phone on nightstand. Unlock phone. Set alarm. Lock phone. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe. Remain still.
